title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #10 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Bible passage says that we are fearfully and wonderfully made? (1 mark)
   A. Matthew 6
   B. Acts 2
   C. Psalm 139
   D. Numbers 22

2. Which statement about God and human beings is true? (1 mark)
   A. God knows each person by name
   B. God knows only the leaders
   C. God has forgotten small children
   D. God knows only adults

3. Which is a healthy way to calm down when you feel angry? (1 mark)
   A. Shout at everyone
   B. Hit the person
   C. Break things
   D. Take deep breaths and count to ten

4. How can a smile help others? (1 mark)
   A. It has no effect
   B. It can cheer up a person who is tired or sad
   C. It makes them angry
   D. It hurts them

5. What is a choice? (1 mark)
   A. A gift from a friend
   B. A decision to do one thing instead of another
   C. A school rule
   D. A kind of food

6. Which question helps you to choose rightly? (1 mark)
   A. What is the cheapest?
   B. Will I get away with it?
   C. Does this agree with what God teaches?
   D. Who will laugh at me?

7. What should you say if someone tries to touch your private parts? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Thank you
   C. Yes please
   D. No, stop!

8. Which parts of the body are private? (1 mark)
   A. The hands
   B. The parts covered by underwear or a swimming costume
   C. The feet
   D. The face

9. The Bible begins by telling us that God is: (1 mark)
   A. A farmer
   B. The Creator of heaven and earth
   C. A king of Egypt
   D. A teacher of the law

10. How many books are in the Old Testament? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 27
   C. 66
   D. 39

11. Which of these is the first book of the New Testament? (1 mark)
   A. Matthew
   B. Romans
   C. Genesis
   D. Acts

12. Why did Zacchaeus climb a tree? (1 mark)
   A. He was collecting fruit
   B. He was short and wanted to see Jesus
   C. He was hiding from the police
   D. He was playing

13. How much would Zacchaeus pay back to anyone he had cheated? (1 mark)
   A. Twice
   B. Half
   C. Four times the amount
   D. Ten times

14. What did the donkey say to Balaam? (1 mark)
   A. Please go home
   B. What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?
   C. Give me water
   D. I am tired

15. Who opened the donkey's mouth? (1 mark)
   A. Balaam
   B. Balak
   C. The Lord
   D. The angel of the king

16. Which people ruled the Israelites during Samson's time? (1 mark)
   A. The Philistines
   B. The Egyptians
   C. The Romans
   D. The Greeks

17. What did Samson find later in the body of the lion? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Bees and honey
   C. Gold
   D. A snake

18. What does it mean to fear God? (1 mark)
   A. To be terrified of Him
   B. To run from Him
   C. To ignore Him
   D. To respect and love Him and obey Him

19. What lesson can we learn from Joseph's plan? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore the future
   B. Plan and save for hard times
   C. Take all the food
   D. Spend everything

20. How old was Abram when he left Haran? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 50
   C. 75
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three ways in which children can care for animals. (3 marks)

22. Explain why we should bless and not curse others. (3 marks)

23. Explain how the story of Balaam teaches obedience to God and respect for those in authority. (5 marks)

24. Explain how a child can show appreciation for God's blessings, using what you learned about Abraham. (5 marks)

25. Describe what happened on the road when Balaam was riding his donkey. (4 marks)

26. Name two people you can tell if you are touched in a way that makes you unsafe. (2 marks)

27. Give two reasons why Zacchaeus climbed the sycamore-fig tree. (2 marks)

28. State two choices that you make at home every day. (2 marks)

29. State two ways of showing respect for the Bible. (2 marks)

30. Why did King Balak ask Balaam for help? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Psalm 139
   Psalm 139:14 speaks of being fearfully and wonderfully made.

2. A — God knows each person by name
   Isaiah 43:1 says that God calls His people by name.

3. D — Take deep breaths and count to ten
   Slowing down helps you to think before acting.

4. B — It can cheer up a person who is tired or sad
   Small acts of kindness like a smile encourage others.

5. B — A decision to do one thing instead of another
   A choice means deciding between different actions.

6. C — Does this agree with what God teaches?
   We measure choices by God's word.

7. D — No, stop!
   Say no loudly and clearly, then move away.

8. B — The parts covered by underwear or a swimming costume
   Private parts are those covered by underwear.

9. B — The Creator of heaven and earth
   Genesis 1:1 tells us God created heaven and earth.

10. D — 39
   The Old Testament has 39 books.

11. A — Matthew
   Matthew is the first of the four Gospels and of the New Testament.

12. B — He was short and wanted to see Jesus
   The crowd was large, and he was short.

13. C — Four times the amount
   He promised to pay back four times.

14. B — What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?
   Numbers 22:28 records the donkey's question.

15. C — The Lord
   The Lord made the donkey speak.

16. A — The Philistines
   The Philistines oppressed Israel in the days of Samson.

17. B — Bees and honey
   Judges 14:8 says a swarm of bees and honey were there.

18. D — To respect and love Him and obey Him
   The fear of God is deep respect.

19. B — Plan and save for hard times
   Joseph advised saving in good years.

20. C — 75
   Genesis 12:4 says he was seventy-five.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give them food and water; protect them from harm; do not beat them; do not overload them; give them shelter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words can build up or break down people. God wants us to love others. Blessing brings peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the power of words, 1 for God's wish for love, 1 for peace.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: God told Balaam what to say and do, and Balaam had to obey even though a king offered rewards. We should obey God's word and instructions from parents and teachers when they are good and right. Disobeying can put us in danger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's instruction, 1 for the reward temptation, 1 for obedience to God, 1 for obeying parents and teachers, 1 for danger of disobedience.

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: Abraham received God's blessings and passed them on. A child can thank God in prayer for family, food, health and school, share with others, obey God, and be a blessing as Abraham was told to be.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for blessings to Abraham, 1 for thanking God, 1 for examples of blessings, 1 for sharing, 1 for obeying or being a blessing.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: The angel stood in the road. The donkey turned into a field and Balaam struck her. Then she pressed against a wall and crushed his foot, and he struck her again. Then she lay down and he struck her a third time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the angel, 1 for turning aside, 1 for the wall and foot, 1 for lying down.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, pastor, nurse, police officer. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid person.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: He was short, the crowd was big, and he wanted to see Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Whether to do chores, to obey parents, to share food, to be kind to siblings. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid choice.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep it clean, carry it carefully, keep it in a high safe place, wash hands before reading, do not write in it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: He was afraid of the Israelites and wanted them to be cursed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fear and 1 mark for wanting the Israelites cursed.
